crossings.evidence: Manual review of lower central knotwork detail: descending light strand is uninterrupted, rising strand is interrupted; hidden continuation interpolated. Draft, not independent ground truth.

limitations: Only crossings between different element polylines are analysed; self-crossings need separate annotations.
Endpoint, vertex and collinear contacts remain ambiguous; no over/under order is inferred.
Observed under-strand continuation through an image interruption is a manual hypothesis, not a visible contour.
Topology sidecar does not suppress clearance violations or establish a sew-out sequence.

source.creator: Albrecht Dürer
source.culturalContext: Embroidery Pattern with Round Medallion in its Center; printed embroidery pattern, not an Arabic or Ukrainian attribution.

permission.evidence: Retained official Met API object 388374 isPublicDomain=true; Met Open Access CC0 policy https://www.metmuseum.org/about-the-met/policies-and-documents/open-access

review.method: Manual review of one lower central knotwork crossing in source resized to 1408 pixels, crop (500,320,350,400), zoom ROI (60,230,130,110)
limitations: Two short approximate strand centrelines only; not full design tracing or independent expert annotations.
Under-strand interruption is interpolated as a continuity hypothesis; its hidden pixels are not observed.
Image geometry is not physically calibrated; no stitch order or machine approval.

geometryBasis: image pixel positions represented in reference units; not physical mm
